same_market: Only the eight original instruments. Long only, no additional leverage. Same USD300k, 0.1% or 0.3% one-way. Strict ex-SNDK independent replay. Actual completed session cutoff tracked in every file. Signals use previous close. Total gross target cap 37.5%.
selection_rule: On two dev windows, require cumulative and alpha >= v69, portfolio average exposure >=95% v69, beta increase <=0.04, and each of the three ratios >= v69 on at least one window. Select most passed windows, then lowest rank sum of Sortino, Calmar, Sharpe and Alpha; version as final tie. Later windows never select candidates. If zero windows pass, nominee is exploratory.
assessment: Keep v49/v69/v70; on requested target window evaluate new candidates, but compare frozen nominee as primary. For historical acceptance require all three ratios and alpha >= v69, cumulative net >= v69, exposure >= v69 and beta increase in [0,0.04]; same main tests at 3x cost and strict no SNDK except exposure/beta with day-aligned control. Date history already used by earlier versions, not prospective.
